priceSource: Coinbase Exchange SOL-USD containing-minute candle close
limitations: Signed native-SOL/WSOL wallet cash difference at each component timestamp, not actual USD proceeds or token-only trading profit.
All-cohort SOL cash includes launches with other quote assets and unresolved/transferred/remaining positions; not full USD profit.

Network fees already contained in signed transaction delta are not subtracted a second time. Exact allocated account-refund components retained per mint; repeated whole-transaction allocations are rejected.

This source covers successful captured history. Failed transaction costs are included only when explicitly allocated into these cash components by the source ledger; unavailable failed history stays unproved.
Buy-route funding is not added independently unless allocated into the source cash components; it can be an internal SOL/WSOL conversion.
Receipt-minute close may be after the receipt within its minute; low/high sensitivity is not a statistical or cross-exchange uncertainty bound.
grossFeePlusClosedCashNetworkOnlyProxyCa: This optional proxy deducts only extra claim network fees from gross fees and omits the claim transaction wallet outflows accounted for in combined-account-cash-summary-usd.json. Do not report it as account cash surplus or complete net profit.
knownNetCoreDefinition: 196 bounded-closed native-SOL quote position signed cashflows including allocated failed transaction fees, plus all verified SOL/WSOL creator-fee receipts, minus additional owner-paid claim network fees once. Historical USD is summed at each individual component timestamp.
